entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker artificer building an army to resist invasion and raising metathran.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker whose light the archangels drive into their home.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Master wizard sceptical about Urza's project.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Academy Chancellor and Barrin's wife.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: Tolarian renegade who experiments on subjects and employs students.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Tolaria student.

entities.name: Davvol
entities.description: Evincar of Rath who rules with cruelty.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: Elf of Llanowar who gives advice and teaches vulgar words in Yavimaya.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Maro-sorcerer of Yavimaya.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem feeling secure about his value.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Artificer whose animal designs echo in Urza's creations.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian master who craves one commodity.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation defended by Capashen knights.

entities.name: Capashen
entities.description: Noble Benalish family of knights.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island with Urza's academy.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Homeland of Keldons.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Warlike people who divide spoils into trophies and ammunition.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Forest ruled by Multani.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane ruled by Davvol.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Army and children created by Urza.

events.summary: A speaker challenges a follower who lived for Serra's love to die for it.
events.quote: Will you not die for it?

events.summary: Students who saw Rayne argue with Urza suspect she summoned a blizzard elemental.
events.quote: Students who had seen Rayne argue with Urza

events.summary: Urza thinks of freedom of the skies rather than war.
events.quote: For a moment, Urza thought not of war and destruction

events.summary: Barrin drowns his doubts about Urza's project in its details.
events.quote: Barrin drowned his doubts about Urza's project

events.summary: Urza constructs an army of sorcery to resist the coming invasion.
events.quote: Urza constructed an army of sorcery and power to resist the coming invasion.

events.summary: Rayne tells Urza she has found more promising students than he and her husband combined.
events.quote: I haven't lost a single one.

events.summary: Gatha boasts that the academy educates and he employs.
Davvol vows to trade life for life with insurgents.
events.quote: I will trade life for life with the insurgents.

events.summary: Davvol finds the rate of spread unacceptable.
events.quote: The rate of spread in this region is unacceptable. Start again.

events.summary: Gatha increases his subjects' stature but not their lifespans.
events.quote: Gatha showed remarkable prowess in increasing his subjects' stature.

events.summary: Gatha falls and is called to account for his abominations.
events.quote: When Gatha fell, he was called to account for each abomination he created.

events.summary: Rofellos contrasts Llanowar's tending of the forest with Yavimaya's being part of it.
events.quote: In Yavimaya, we are a part of them.

events.summary: Multani tells Rofellos they are both of Gaea and equal.
events.quote: We are both of Gaea, and thus we are equal.

events.summary: Rofellos teaches Yavimaya's elves vulgar words to Multani's chagrin.
As the invasion nears, Urza's means resemble Phyrexia's end.
events.quote: As the invasion drew closer, Urza's means began to resemble Phyrexia's end.

events.summary: Urza's metathran children are produced by integrated machines.
events.quote: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

events.summary: Rayne urges Urza to think like a father.

relations.note: Barrin calls Rayne his wife through Rayne's quote about her husband.
relations.quote: you and my husband have, combined
Urza constructed an army of sorcery and power
